g.text: Did you truly find yourself so otherwise bereft of options that you resorted to petitioning Roathe to badger me on your behalf in order to... consider an apology?
Did you truly find yourself so otherwise bereft of options that you resorted to petitioning Roathe to badger me on your behalf in order to send M. Loid upstairs?
Did you truly find yourself so otherwise bereft of options that you resorted to petitioning Roathe to badger me on your behalf?
You realize how farcical that sounds, yes?
I do not wish to waste more time than I have already lost listening to his argument. I will simply say very well.
The issue, correct me if I am wrong, was that you did not wish to wade through my past. Now you seem to have changed your mind?
I didn't know he said I'd apologize.
I didn't know what else to do. I know it's ridiculous in hindsight.
I do not understand. We cannot go back. Those waters cannot be retread.
The comical nature of it, I admit, is part of what made me come and investigate. Are you so distraught? I cannot imagine the lack of my companionship in your life is so terrible a thing.
You shall have my assistance as you request. I pity what your attack devil will do next to Marie.
You shall have my assistance as you request. Now please, call off your attack devil.
Oh. Well, this was a massive waste of time then, wasn't it?
I guess I... will simply say I am sorry, then. For not listening to you.
It is, Lyon. I care about you. Immensely. And I know I misstepped with you badly.
May I ask why you did not? Were you afraid of the subject matter? Bored by it, perhaps? Or did you think you were not strong enough to weather it?
And I am so very, very sorry.
I didn't think I was strong enough to take it on.
I didn't care at the time. But I do, now.
I didn't know what else to do but to turn to Roathe for help.
Then I have no choice but to forgive you.
And what has changed that makes you suddenly care, when previously you did not?
I am left without any other option but to forgive you, of course. I do not know why you would want such a broken thing such as I, cluttering up your spaces.
我改變我對你的看法了。
I feel there is progress that might be blocked behind hearing your stories.
But I find that my annoyance over your words fades now that I know the absolutely bizarre lengths you will go to to have me at your side.
